mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates tightening monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.2% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as companies adapt to new labor market conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and coincides with a rising GDP (GDPC1), it signals strengthening supply chains and increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising RSAFS (above $650B) signals sustained consumer spending, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS > $650B.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 4% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy and low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in PAYEMS (above 150K) coinciding with a low UNRATE (below 3.5%) signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when PAYEMS > 150K and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and stable INDPRO (above 100) signals robust supply chains, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100.
